seo.title: Automated billing on Recurly · Chase Teichmann
seo.description: I automated ReturnLogic’s billing on Recurly. It had cost our VP of Operations about ten minutes per retailer every cycle; after it, adding retailers stopped adding work.

gallery.title: A scheduled job bills every retailer each cycle, with no one running it by hand.
gallery.desc: Illustration: a long receipt with a torn edge and a round recurring-arrow badge, with a sticker reading auto-billed every cycle.
gallery.caption: A scheduled job bills every retailer each cycle, with no one running it by hand.

sections.label: By hand vs. automated
sections.html:
By hand, every weekly and monthly cycle
  1. Run the usage queries
  2. Enter each retailer’s charges into Recurly
  3. Download the invoice
  4. Email it with the usage report
Nearly 7 hours a month at 40 retailers.
Automated
  1. A scheduled job compiles each retailer’s usage report
  2. Posts the charges to Recurly
  3. Emails the invoice
  4. Retailers find every report and invoice in the app
No manual work, however many retailers.

sections.label: What a bill covered
sections.html: Each return (RMA) at that retailer’s own price, shipping labels for retailers on our managed shipping integration, and any add-on features they used.

sections.label: Safe to re-run
sections.html: Every posted charge was recorded in Postgres, so re-running a failed cycle skipped what had already posted instead of charging a retailer twice.
